# Momentum

> A cozy focus OS for ADHD brains — tasks, calendar, focus timer, and habits.

Momentum helps people with executive dysfunction get moving through a
sensory-friendly interface: a brain-dump compiler that turns messy thoughts
into small tasks, a single-focus timer, weekly and monthly calendars, and
tiny habit chains.

- [Home](/): Momentum app — Compiler, Quest Log, Focus, Calendar, Weekly, Habits
